newsitem.title: USA: Boston $600 million convention center bill emerges.
newsitem.headline: Boston $600 million convention center bill emerges.

text.p: A Massachusetts House committee passed a $667.5 million funding measure for capital projects around the state including $600 million for a convention center in Boston.
The legislation, which will be debated on the floor of the House next Monday, calls for tax increases and a $165 million contribution from the city of Boston.

Sources of revenue include occupancy taxes from new hotels, a surcharge on sight-seeing tours, parking fees, a $10 surcharge on rental cars in Boston, and a 2.7 percent increase in hotel excise taxes in Boston, Cambridge, Springfield and Worcester.
The legislation also calls for $19 million to complete a convention center in Worcester and $48.5 million for a convention center in Springfield.

An additional $50 million for general obligation bonds, with $25 million earmarked for upgrading the Basketball Hall of Fame in Springfield, was also included in the bill. ((Boston bureau, (617) 367-4106))
